metric.name: 4. Memory Efficiency (RAM Consumption)
metric.statistic: Mean sampled browser plus Python backend process-tree RSS; sampled peak and failures are retained in evidence.
metric.scope: Resident/working-set sum in decimal MB; shared pages may be counted more than once, and sampling can miss short peaks.

evidence.statistic: sum of process-tree RSS / working sets
evidence.shared_page_caveat: Shared pages may be counted in more than one process; this is not unique physical RAM. Sampled peaks can miss shorter allocation spikes.
evidence.aggregation: Pooled successful raw sample observations across repeats; failed samples remain in counts.

source_fingerprint.algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted path + NUL + file SHA-256 + newline

production_build.scope: Existing production frontend/dist files, separate from raw-source storage
production_build.source_build_linkage: Unverified: build files are fingerprinted, but a compiler-attested source-to-build mapping is not available. Rebuild immediately before runtime measurements.
